verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents bill management, due-date tracking, scheduled vendor payments, and Bills and Bill Vendors API resources. None of the evidence mentions an accounts payable aging report, vendor balance reporting, or point-in-time (as-of date) views. The documented reports list names Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry and Payments Collected, not AP aging. Bill tracking is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
